commerce_events_amount_check.name: commerce_events_amount_check
commerce_events_amount_check.value: "commerce_events"."amount_minor" IS NULL OR ("amount_minor" <> '' AND "amount_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

coupons_value_shape_check.name: coupons_value_shape_check
coupons_value_shape_check.value:
("coupons"."type" = 'fixed' AND "coupons"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "coupons"."currency_decimals" IS NOT NULL AND "coupons"."value_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "coupons"."value_bps" IS NULL) OR
				("coupons"."type" = 'percentage' AND "coupons"."value_minor" IS NULL AND
				 "coupons"."value_bps" IS NOT NULL AND "coupons"."value_bps" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)

coupons_currency_shape_check.name: coupons_currency_shape_check
coupons_currency_shape_check.value:
("coupons"."currency" IS NULL AND "coupons"."currency_decimals" IS NULL) OR
				("coupons"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "coupons"."currency_decimals" BETWEEN 0 AND 8)

coupons_monetary_scope_check.name: coupons_monetary_scope_check
coupons_monetary_scope_check.value:
("coupons"."minimum_order_minor" IS NULL AND "coupons"."maximum_discount_minor" IS NULL) OR
				"coupons"."currency" IS NOT NULL

coupons_minimum_order_check.name: coupons_minimum_order_check
coupons_minimum_order_check.value: "coupons"."minimum_order_minor" IS NULL OR ("minimum_order_minor" <> '' AND "minimum_order_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

coupons_maximum_discount_check.name: coupons_maximum_discount_check
coupons_maximum_discount_check.value: "coupons"."maximum_discount_minor" IS NULL OR ("maximum_discount_minor" <> '' AND "maximum_discount_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

coupons_scope_json_check.name: coupons_scope_json_check
coupons_scope_json_check.value:
json_valid("coupons"."scope_json") AND json_type("coupons"."scope_json") = 'object'
				AND json_type("coupons"."scope_json", '$.productIds') = 'array'
				AND json_type("coupons"."scope_json", '$.tagNames') = 'array'

delivery_records_content_shape_check.name: delivery_records_content_shape_check
delivery_records_content_shape_check.value:
("delivery_records"."content_encrypted" IS NULL AND "delivery_records"."content_key_version" IS NULL) OR
				("delivery_records"."content_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_records"."content_key_version" > 0)

entitlement_events_shape_check.name: entitlement_events_shape_check
entitlement_events_shape_check.value:
(
				"entitlement_events"."kind" = 'usage'
				AND "entitlement_events"."event_type" IN ('consumed', 'restored')
				AND "entitlement_events"."amount" > 0
				AND "entitlement_events"."source_type" IS NOT NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."source_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."asset_type" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."asset_id" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."consumed" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."actor_type" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."request_id" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."ip_address" IS NULL
			) OR (
				"entitlement_events"."kind" = 'access'
				AND "entitlement_events"."event_type" IN ('revealed', 'downloaded', 'email_content_sent', 'copied', 'link_sent')
				AND "entitlement_events"."amount" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."source_type" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."source_id" IS NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."asset_type" IS NOT NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "entitlement_events"."consumed" IN (0, 1)
				AND "entitlement_events"."actor_type" IN ('customer', 'admin', 'system')
			)

notification_channel_configs_key_version.name: notification_channel_configs_key_version_check
notification_channel_configs_key_version.value:
("notification_channel_configs"."api_key_encrypted" IS NULL AND "notification_channel_configs"."api_key_version" IS NULL) OR
				("notification_channel_configs"."api_key_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_channel_configs"."api_key_version" > 0)

notification_deliveries_asset_shape_chec.name: notification_deliveries_asset_shape_check
notification_deliveries_asset_shape_chec.value:
("notification_deliveries"."entitlement_id" IS NULL AND "notification_deliveries"."asset_type" IS NULL AND
				 "notification_deliveries"."asset_id" IS NULL AND "notification_deliveries"."access_event_type" IS NULL) OR
				("notification_deliveries"."entitlement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_deliveries"."asset_type" IS NOT NULL AND
				 "notification_deliveries"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_deliveries"."access_event_type" IS NOT NULL)

notification_subscriptions_destination_c.name: notification_subscriptions_destination_check
notification_subscriptions_destination_c.value:
("notification_subscriptions"."destination_encrypted" IS NULL AND "notification_subscriptions"."destination_key_version" IS NULL) OR
				("notification_subscriptions"."destination_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_subscriptions"."destination_key_version" > 0)

payment_attempts_subject_check.name: payment_attempts_subject_check
payment_attempts_subject_check.value:
("payment_attempts"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."wallet_topup_id" IS NULL) OR
				("payment_attempts"."order_id" IS NULL AND "payment_attempts"."wallet_topup_id" IS NOT NULL)

payment_channels_credential_shape_check.name: payment_channels_credential_shape_check
payment_channels_credential_shape_check.value:
("payment_channels"."credential_encrypted" IS NULL AND "payment_channels"."credential_key_version" IS NULL) OR
				("payment_channels"."credential_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_channels"."credential_key_version" > 0)

product_sellable_items_list_price_minor_.name: product_sellable_items_list_price_minor_check
product_sellable_items_list_price_minor_.value: "product_sellable_items"."list_price_minor" IS NULL OR ("list_price_minor" <> '' AND "list_price_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

product_sellable_items_cost_minor_check.name: product_sellable_items_cost_minor_check
product_sellable_items_cost_minor_check.value: "product_sellable_items"."cost_minor" IS NULL OR ("cost_minor" <> '' AND "cost_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

product_sellable_items_supplier_status_c.name: product_sellable_items_supplier_status_check
product_sellable_items_supplier_status_c.value:
("product_sellable_items"."fulfillment_source" = 'local' AND "product_sellable_items"."supplier_status" IS NULL) OR
				("product_sellable_items"."fulfillment_source" = 'supplier' AND "product_sellable_items"."supplier_status" IS NOT NULL)

product_sellable_items_automation_creden.name: product_sellable_items_automation_credential_check
product_sellable_items_automation_creden.value:
("product_sellable_items"."automation_credential_encrypted" IS NULL AND "product_sellable_items"."automation_credential_key_version" IS NULL) OR
				("product_sellable_items"."automation_credential_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "product_sellable_items"."automation_credential_key_version" > 0)

products_trash_shape_check.name: products_trash_shape_check
products_trash_shape_check.value:
("products"."status" = 'trashed' AND "products"."trashed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR
				("products"."status" <> 'trashed' AND "products"."trashed_at" IS NULL)

shop_order_events_transition_check.name: shop_order_events_transition_check
shop_order_events_transition_check.value:
("shop_order_events"."from_status" IS NULL AND "shop_order_events"."to_status" IS NULL) OR
				("shop_order_events"."from_status" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_order_events"."to_status" IS NOT NULL AND
				 "shop_order_events"."from_status" <> "shop_order_events"."to_status")

shop_order_events_case_shape_check.name: shop_order_events_case_shape_check

("shop_order_events"."after_sale_case_id" IS NULL AND "shop_order_events"."case_action" IS NULL) OR
				("shop_order_events"."after_sale_case_id" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_order_events"."case_action" IS NOT NULL)

shop_order_items_unit_cost_check.name: shop_order_items_unit_cost_check
shop_order_items_unit_cost_check.value: "shop_order_items"."unit_cost_minor" IS NULL OR ("unit_cost_minor" <> '' AND "unit_cost_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

shop_order_items_email_content_check.name: shop_order_items_email_content_check
shop_order_items_email_content_check.value:
"shop_order_items"."email_mode" <> 'content' OR
				("shop_order_items"."delivery_component_type" = 'stock' AND
				 "shop_order_items"."duration_ms" IS NULL AND "shop_order_items"."usage_limit" IS NULL AND
				 "shop_order_items"."access_limit" IS NULL)

supplier_accounts_balance_check.name: supplier_accounts_balance_check
supplier_accounts_balance_check.value: "supplier_accounts"."balance_minor" IS NULL OR ("balance_minor" <> '' AND "balance_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

supplier_orders_total_cost_check.name: supplier_orders_total_cost_check
supplier_orders_total_cost_check.value: "supplier_orders"."total_cost_minor" IS NULL OR ("total_cost_minor" <> '' AND "total_cost_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')

supplier_orders_account_shape_check.name: supplier_orders_account_shape_check
supplier_orders_account_shape_check.value:
("supplier_orders"."selected_account_id" IS NULL AND
				 "supplier_orders"."selected_credentials_revision" IS NULL AND
				 "supplier_orders"."provider_request_no" IS NULL AND
				 "supplier_orders"."account_locked_at" IS NULL) OR
				("supplier_orders"."selected_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND
				 "supplier_orders"."selected_credentials_revision" > 0 AND
				 "supplier_orders"."provider_request_no" IS NOT NULL)

supplier_orders_cost_shape_check.name: supplier_orders_cost_shape_check
supplier_orders_cost_shape_check.value:
("supplier_orders"."quoted_unit_cost_minor" IS NULL AND "supplier_orders"."total_cost_minor" IS NULL) OR
				("supplier_orders"."quoted_unit_cost_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "supplier_orders"."total_cost_minor" IS NOT NULL)

operation_task_runs_artifact_retention_i.name: operation_task_runs_artifact_retention_idx
